## Visible changes

Leave this section empty when the PR does not change UI, keymap, rendering, interaction, or performance feel. Required from M1's inbox PR onward for anything the user sees or touches. See CONTRIBUTING.md and docs/scope.md.

- [ ] Screenshots of the running app are attached (before/after when changing existing UI, several window sizes)
- [ ] A short recording of the keyboard flow is attached
- [ ] UX judges are independent (they did not write the code) and scored the running app, not just the diff
